description: Get the full details of one TripWays tour by bokun_id (the number in tripways.com/t/{id}): summary, itinerary stops, inclusions and exclusions, languages, cancellation policy, meeting point or pickup, from-price, rating, hero_image, url, and checkout_url. Live dates and group totals come from check_availability and get_price_quote.
name: get_tour_details
title: Get tour details
